title: Mixtape and Detention
author: Kestrel Oyelaran
blurb: Hazel Pemberton, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
